lines.text: A little room. A whole world.
Novelist Workspace. A quiet place to write a novel, and to read one.
Write on a clean page, with your chapters beside you and your private notes in the margin.
Plan it as chapters, as a board of scenes, or as a notebook of people and places.
Keep a streak. Race the clock in a sprint, and watch the words add up.
Bring a manuscript in from Word. Send it out the same way.
Then read. Other writers' novels, in the light or the dark, opening where you left off.
And it all comes with you. The same novels, on your phone.
A little room. A whole world.
